summary.en: Signs in to MonkeyCode (China and international) and BaiZhiCloud, and serves their models to every agent magpie runs: browser sign-in or API key, gateway request signing, quota and credits, daily check-in.
summary.zh: 签入 MonkeyCode 国内站、国际站与百智云，把它们的模型提供给 magpie 里的每个 agent：浏览器登录或 API Key、网关请求签名、额度与积分、每日签到。
